The '''2015–16 Washington Huskies men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Washington]] in the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Huskies were led by fourteenth-year head coach [[Lorenzo Romar]]. They played their games at Alaska Airlines Arena at [[Hec Edmundson Pavilion]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 19–15, 9–9 in Pac-12 play to finish in a three-way tie for sixth place. They defeated [[2015–16 Stanford Cardinal men's basketball team|Stanford]] in the first round of the [[2016 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2015–16 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]]. They were invited to the [[2016 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2015–16 Long Beach State 49ers men's basketball team|Long Beach State]] in the first round to advance to the second round where they lost to [[2015–16 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]].

==Previous season==
The [[2014–15 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|2014–15 Washington Huskies]] finished the season with an overall record of 16–15, and 5–13 in the Pac-12 conference play. Lost to [[2014–15 Stanford Cardinal men's basketball team|Stanford]] in the first round of the [[2015 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]].
